text:
maria: Heads up - provisioning queue spiked in eu-west2, a bunch of GPU nodes stuck in "agent-waiting". OOB console connections failing for multiple racks.

devon: seeing same. OOB console errors show "session rate limit exceeded". BMC logs: repeated "transport reset" and lots of sflow exports.

ops_toby: quick triage - looks like an MTU mismatch on the outboard bridge between ToR and OOB switch. sFlow exporters are saturating the OOB switch control-plane CPU and dropping management packets.

jess: timeline? what changed right before the spike?

maria: rolled switch firmware v2.1.3 to the OOB cluster at ~05:10 UTC, the build enabled sFlow by default. The sampling accidentally set to high (1:10).

devon: also noticed a handful of chassis bounced and had secureboot toggles flip after the push. Not sure if related but they coincided. BMC reboots triggered transient bootflag toggles.

ops_toby: probable root cause: large sFlow datagrams with MTU mismatch (ToR 1500 vs OOB bridge 900) cause fragmentation; control-plane CPU spends cycles reassembling/handling, then soft-parks and drops IPMI/IP-over-LAN. Result: BMC session backoff and provisioning queue fills.

jess: can we hotfix this quickly? what's the minimal runbook?

maria: runbook snippet (doing live):
```
1) disable sflow on cluster: /usr/local/bin/sflowctl stop
2) apply MTU 900 on outboard bridge: ip link set dev br-oob mtu 900
3) restart bmc-proxy on jump hosts: systemctl restart bmc-proxy
4) restart provisioning agent: systemctl restart prov-agent
5) drain/requeue stuck nodes: provctl drain <node-id> && provctl reprovision <node-id>
```

devon: executing step1 on eu-west2-obr1 now... :white_check_mark: sFlow stopped.

ops_toby: applying MTU change on br-oob across eu-west2 racks. Watch for hosts using jumbo frames (infra:storage).

maria: OOB sessions recovering. BMC session backlog clearing. Provisioning queue dropped from 520 -> 18 within ~6 minutes.

jess: any customer impact or pool evictions? cost spikes?

devon: small transient evictions in a couple of dedicated pools; auto-heal triggered. No sustained cost impact. We'll keep an eye on preemptible replacements but looks contained.

ops_toby: follow-ups: schedule firmware rollback or config patch to ensure sFlow default is off, add a guard to reject sampling > 1:1000, and add an alert on OOB control-plane CPU > 60%. Also add a check that bridge MTU config is consistent across ToR -> oob switches.

maria: filing INF-6123 for firmware flag + runbook improvements, tagging @platform-sre for follow-up.

infra-bot: deploy-bot: firmware rollback plan scheduled for 06:40 UTC (INF-6123); canary on rack-3.

jess: reminder: audit nodes where secure-boot flipped and revert if necessary. Add to postmortem.

devon: bumping prov-agent backoff to 45s for now to tolerate short BMC disconnects, monitoring for requeues.

maria: thanks team :thumbsup: will draft a short postmortem and include the runbook changes and the sFlow guard.
